r0-context.title: Load baseline context
r0-context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-crew.md and references/global-everyone.md), then the project deltas if present: docs/agents/CREW_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, plus the handoff, the diff, and the relevant packet. Record pass when loaded.
r0-context.finding: Loaded inherited/project doctrine, G2 reviewer handoff, frozen imperative, implementer result, persisted 11-path inventory/helper, full scoped implementation/tests/docs, and current diff. Recomputed digest first: sha256:bcac2c18ac5a6d88883f6123d173b72d4f020fd457b42b4b04268674a481abd5, exact match.

r1-handoff.title: Handoff compliance
r1-handoff.imperative: Did the change do what the handoff asked, within its allowed scope? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r1-handoff.finding: BLOCK: adversarial public-interface probes expose four frozen-contract defects. (1) Two fixed-boundary material deltas with an escalation for only intent_and_why are accepted, leaving fixed_decisions un-escalated. (2) An unlaunched issue id may collide with launched current issue A. (3) a valid exact-G1 parked array with duplicate nonempty strings is rejected by extra uniqueness not present in G1. (4) a rewritten full G1 issue whose blocks target B exists in the result current wave is rejected because replacement validation isolates the issue. Digest itself matches bcac2c18....

r2-scope.title: Scope drift
r2-scope.imperative: Did the change stay inside allowed scope and respect specific exclusions? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r2-scope.finding: The exact 11-path digest inventory is confined to lean replan skill/verifier/templates/docs, registration/index updates, and focused tests. No checklist engine is bundled, no G3 role lifecycle wiring or compatibility alias appears, and the verifier imports only stdlib plus the local G1 shape rail. No tracker/network mutation path exists.

r3-evidence.title: Required evidence
r3-evidence.imperative: Is the required evidence present and does it actually demonstrate the behavior? Record pass/fail with a finding.
r3-evidence.finding: Focused GREEN reproduces exactly (133 passed, 407 subtests), registration passes, digest matches, helper wiring is live, and scoped diff check passes. BLOCK: required behavior evidence is incomplete because the suite omits multi-fixed escalation completeness, launched/unlaunched cross-partition collision, exact-G1 duplicate compatibility, and dependency-aware issue replacement; the adversarial probe demonstrates all four defects against the public verifier.

r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: The skill is lean, explicit, offline, and semantically well documented, but inherited fail-fast/interface rules are not met: invalid identity/escalation states are accepted and valid exact-G1 nested values are refused. Seven concrete checks were appended and will be visited individually.

r5-reconciliation.title: Reconciliation check
r5-reconciliation.imperative: Does the change diverge from the recorded architecture in a way Commander must reconcile? Record pass/fail; flag a triage candidate if it is out of scope.
r5-reconciliation.finding: No architecture map exists and structural anchors/scope notes are accurate, but the capability/constraint claim that the seam enforces strict exact-G1 values, identity partition, and every fixed-boundary escalation is materially overstated by the accepted/refused adversarial cases. This is in-scope G2 rework, not an out-of-scope triage candidate.

r6-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler code smells)
r6-fowler.imperative: Run the refactoring / code-smell pass (SKILL.md 'Refactoring pass'). Render a verdict on each Fowler baseline smell (long method, large class, duplicated code, feature envy, data clumps, primitive obsession, long parameter list, shotgun surgery, divergent change, message chains, speculative generality, comments-as-deodorant): flagged / overridden / absent. Smells are judgment calls, ALWAYS subordinate to the repo's documented standards — an override needs a logged standard + reason. Record the pass to templates/FOWLER_PASS.template.json, run scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <record> (it refuses a skipped smell or an unlogged override), then record pass/fail with a finding. Do NOT silently skip this item.
constraints: Fowler smells are subordinate to documented repo standards; never hard violations
an override (smell not flagged because a standard wins) needs a logged reason
r6-fowler.finding: Fowler rail passed 12/12 entries. BLOCKING smell: feature envy in nested G1 validation—synthetic whole-plan rewrites reach through the G1 seam and discard real result graph context, directly causing valid dependency-aware issue replacements to be refused. Primitive JSON representation is explicitly overridden by the frozen versioned-artifact standard; other smells absent.

r4a-schema.title: Strict exact-G1 schemas
r4a-schema.imperative: Verify every v1 input/result field, nested G1 shape, type, enum, cardinality, unknown, and fail-fast rule, including acceptance of every valid exact-G1 value.
r4a-schema.finding: BLOCK: strict core fields/enums/cardinalities are implemented, but exact-G1 compatibility is not. A G1-valid revised_parked array with duplicate nonempty strings is refused by replan-only uniqueness. A full G1 issue replacement whose blocks target B exists in the result wave is refused because the replacement is validated in a synthetic one-issue plan.

r4b-decisions.title: Four decisions and dispositions
r4b-decisions.imperative: Verify advance/repair/replan/stop rules and exactly one classification-matched disposition for every discrepancy and unlaunched item.
r4b-decisions.finding: All four decision enums verify; only stop may use null current_wave; repair holds wave and forecast exactly; every discrepancy/unlaunched item must be dispositioned once; classification/action mappings are exact; evidence-only/drop enforce issue_created=false; rewrite replacement is required only for rewrite.

r4c-identity.title: Identity partitions and stability
r4c-identity.imperative: Verify completed/open/unlaunched identity partitions are unambiguous and applicable outputs preserve launched identities.
r4c-identity.finding: BLOCK: completed/open current IDs are unique, disjoint, complete, and applicable output preserves open issue objects. However unlaunched issue id A is accepted while A is already a launched current issue, so the launched/unlaunched partition is ambiguous and the launched-work-stable boundary can be bypassed.

r4d-escalation.title: Typed fixed-boundary escalation
r4d-escalation.imperative: Verify every fixed delta is covered by correct boundary-typed escalation and the result is inapplicable.
r4d-escalation.finding: BLOCK: each boundary verifies in isolation with the correct proposed-value type and applicable=false. But a packet with fixed deltas on intent_and_why and fixed_decisions plus only an intent escalation is accepted. The singular escalation need only match any fixed change, so not every fixed-boundary delta is escalated.

r4e-offline.title: Offline renderer and CLI
r4e-offline.imperative: Verify the renderer/CLI perform no tracker or network writes and emit nonempty wave-review and epic output.
r4e-offline.finding: Direct template CLI replay exits 0 and emits nonempty Wave review and Current planning truth Markdown. Verifier/renderer use only stdlib file/JSON operations plus local verify_issue_set; no socket, subprocess, tracker, gh, HTTP, or write operation exists. The focused deny-socket test also passes.

r4f-goodness.title: Semantic skill goodness
r4f-goodness.imperative: Judge completion sharpness, actionable steps, negative space, epistemic honesty, bounded evidence, and independent-review compatibility.
r4f-goodness.finding: Skill prose passes actionability, negative space, epistemic honesty, completion sharpness, and independent-review routing. BLOCK on bounded evidence/compatibility: the claimed verifier boundary is broader than the tested behavior, and valid exact-G1 values cannot reliably traverse the seam; independent review therefore cannot accept the stated completion claim.

r4g-lean.title: Lean bounded capability
r4g-lean.imperative: Verify no checklist engine, numeric confidence, generalized decision language, tracker mutation, alias, portfolio policy, or G3 lifecycle wiring.
r4g-lean.finding: The capability remains a lean judgment contract: no checklist engine, numeric confidence, generic policy language, autonomous portfolio behavior, tracker mutation, compatibility alias, or G3 Explorer/Commander/Admiral lifecycle wiring. The agent chooses; code only validates/renders.
